messages:
Maya (CS): Hi team — Brightpoint renewal check. Customer agreed to 12mo renewal but procurement wants to split payment: 50% wire now, 50% CC after go-live. Need sign-off on amendment + updated invoice. PO still pending. Any blockers?
Tom (AE): Noted. Account is Brightpoint. Can finance accept split? looping in Chris.
Chris (Finance): Wire OK, but we need W9 on file and exact billing entity. Also need billing contact for CC capture. If they want two invoices we can do that; otherwise need clear invoice line items and payment schedule. Did they request net45?
Lena (Legal): We can accommodate a split payment via an amendment. I'll draft language for payment schedule and remittance. Need the customer's legal/billing entity name and EIN if available.
Maya (CS): Billing entity per SOW: Brightpoint Inc., EIN 12-3456789. Billing contact is sara@brightpoint.com. PO they quoted verbally is BP-2026-149 but procurement hasn't uploaded it yet.
Jenna (Onboarding): FYI go-live planned 2026-05-10. If second payment is post go-live, do we want to limit premium features until final payment?
Tom (AE): Customer said they'd prefer full access now. They requested pro-rated seats in the amendment. Proposed schedule: 50% wire due 2026-05-05, remainder charged to card 2026-08-01.
Chris (Finance): For wire please send procurement our wire instructions and remittance name. I'll prepare invoice PDF. For CC we'll need tokenization — can we use our hosted billing link? @Maya (CS)
Maya (CS): Yes, we can accept CC via billing portal. I'll send the portal link to Sara. Also they asked for DocuSign. @DocuSign-bot, create envelope from template 'Renewal_Amendment_v2' and include PO placeholder.
DocuSign-bot: Envelope created REN-2123456789. Link: https://docusign.example/envelope/REN-2123456789
Lena (Legal): Drafted amendment and sent to Sara for signature. Added clause for payment schedule and a brief refund/credits policy if enablement deliverables are missed. Left PO field blank to insert BP PO once received.
Maya (CS): Procurement just uploaded W9 and PO BP-2026-149 to their SOW folder. I'll attach to Salesforce. @Chris (Finance) please confirm invoice schedule so I can reply to procurement.
Chris (Finance): Confirmed. I'll issue Invoice #INV-44321 for the first wire. Wire instructions attached in email. For the second payment we'll schedule a CC charge and send the billing link.
Tom (AE): Quick Q — procurement prefers a single invoice and will split internally. Any objections to issuing one invoice with payment schedule lines?
Chris (Finance): Prefer separate invoices for clarity, but can do single invoice with clear split timeline and line items if legal signs off. Slightly more complex for reconciliation but workable.
Lena (Legal): Single invoice OK as long as the amendment clearly states split payment dates and amounts. I'll add explicit language: 'Payments may be requested on a split schedule; Redwood may issue one or more invoice documents reflecting such schedule.'
Maya (CS): Plan: Lena finalizes amendment, Chris prepares invoice(s), Tom confirms final schedule with customer, I'll monitor DocuSign and update SFDC. Will post back when signed. :thumbsup:
Sara (Brightpoint): Thanks all — I've uploaded PO BP-2026-149 and our W9. We'll sign amendment today. Wire is scheduled for 2026-05-04 and CC will be available to charge on 2026-08-01.
DocuSign-bot: Envelope REN-2123456789 completed. Signed by Sara Brightpoint. SignedAt: 2123460899
Maya (CS): Amendment signed and payment timeline confirmed. I'll update SFDC, invoice status, and onboarding checklist. Closing the loop — thanks everyone! :party-popper:
